title: Darling in the FranXX
native_title: ダーリン・イン・ザ・フランキス
source: Darling in the FranXX anime by Trigger and A-1 Pictures (24 episodes).
world: In a far future, children raised as pilots live on mobile fortress-cities called Plantations and fight giant Klaxosaurs in paired mechs called FranXX. Hiro, a failed pilot, meets Zero Two, a mysterious girl with red horns known as the 'partner killer', and becomes her 'darling'. With Squad 13 they uncover the truth about APE, the Klaxosaurs and the alien VIRM. Mecha action with a coming-of-age love story.
power_system: A FranXX needs a boy (Stamen) and a girl (Pistil) pilot whose minds sync. Zero Two is part Klaxosaur. Strelizia is Hiro and Zero Two's FranXX.

places.name: Mistilteinn

groups.name: Squad 13
groups.line: Hiro, Zero Two, Ichigo, Goro, Kokoro, Mitsuru, Zorome, Futoshi, Ikuno and Miku (not Miku Nakano).

groups.name: APE
groups.line: The organisation ruling the Plantations, led by Papa.

terms.line: Zero Two's book about a beast and a prince.

timeline.summary: Hiro meets Zero Two and pilots Strelizia.
Hiro and Zero Two's childhood bond is revealed.
Hiro and Zero Two fight VIRM in space and sacrifice themselves; in the epilogue they are reborn.
